memo: Work WS/MP410/2024-2025/118427, 'high mast led light 95 mtrs ms pole with 6 led', was sanctioned for Rs 16,30,000 on 04 December 2024 by District Magistrate, Budaun, on a recommendation made 268 days earlier on 11 March 2024. Rs 10,62,000 has been disbursed across 3 payments, 34.85% below the sanctioned amount, and no payment has been recorded in the 409 days since 11 July 2025. The same description appears on 244 works under this agency; two are cited above for comparison and should be opened before any conclusion is drawn, because repeated works of this kind are often legitimate. This agency carries 7 other HIGH cases in FY2024-2025. Execution time could not be assessed because no completion has been reported, so 20 of the 144 rulebook points could not be evaluated and this case is scored on 86% coverage.
